description: This file defines mock classes for HTTP cache testing, including MockDiskEntry, MockDiskCache, and related factory classes, used for unit testing HTTP cache components in Chromium.

classes.name: MockDiskEntry
classes.description: A mock implementation of disk_cache::Entry for testing, supporting deferred operations and failure simulation.

classes.name: MockDiskCache
classes.description: A mock implementation of disk_cache::Backend, managing MockDiskEntry instances for testing cache behavior.

classes.name: MockBackendFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating mock disk cache backends.

classes.name: MockHttpCache
classes.description: A mock HTTP cache class that wraps around a disk cache backend and provides utility functions for testing.

classes.name: MockDiskCacheNoCB
classes.description: A variant of MockDiskCache that does not invoke CreateEntry callbacks.

classes.name: MockBackendNoCbFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating mock backends without invoking callbacks.

classes.name: MockBlockingBackendFactory
classes.description: A factory that controls backend instantiation and allows blocking and finishing creation.

methods.name: Doom
methods.description: Marks the disk cache entry as doomed.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns the key associated with the cache entry.

methods.name: GetLastUsed
methods.description: Returns the last used time of the cache entry.

methods.name: GetLastModified
methods.description: Returns the last modified time of the cache entry.

methods.name: GetDataSize
methods.description: Returns the size of data at a given index.

methods.name: ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from the cache entry.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes data to the cache entry.

methods.name: ReadSparseData
methods.description: Reads sparse data from the cache entry.

methods.name: WriteSparseData
methods.description: Writes sparse data to the cache entry.

methods.name: GetAvailableRange
methods.description: Gets available data range in the cache entry.

methods.name: CouldBeSparse
methods.description: Indicates if the entry could be sparse.

methods.name: ReadyForSparseIO
methods.description: Prepares the entry for sparse IO.

methods.name: SetLastUsedTimeForTest
methods.description: Sets last used time for testing.
